Returns board rows with visits, MoM, organic share, DR, registration date and confidence. Use list_categories for val

tools.name: top_rising
tools.description: The top N of this month's rising-sites board (ordered by absolute monthly-visit growth), optionally within one category. Requires a New Site Radar Pro API key (Authorization: Bearer nsr_… or x-api-key: nsr_…; https://newsiteradar.com/mcp).

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Category slugs on the current board (with site counts), plus the valid values for search_sites filters (type, visits, mom, payment). Requires a New Site Radar Pro API key (Authorization: Bearer nsr_… or x-api-key: nsr_…; https://newsiteradar.com/mcp).

tools.name: model_releases
tools.description: Newest AI model releases from 26 labs (official announcements, blogs, open-weights repos), optionally by company and since a date. Requires a New Site Radar Pro API key (Authorization: Bearer nsr_… or x-api-key: nsr_…; https://newsiteradar.com/mcp).
